channel.title: Extreme-Ownership Daily
channel.description: A short daily study working through the 12 principles of Extreme-Ownership by Jocko Willink and Leif Babin. Each pass through the book applies the principles through a different lens: as a disciple of Jesus Christ, as a Warrant Officer and engineer in the Army National Guard, as an electrical contractor running his own business, and as a husband and father. New episodes weekdays.
channel.itunes:author: Heber Haws
channel.itunes:summary: A short daily study working through the 12 principles of Extreme-Ownership by Jocko Willink and Leif Babin. Each pass through the book applies the principles through a different lens: as a disciple of Jesus Christ, as a Warrant Officer and engineer in the Army National Guard, as an electrical contractor running his own business, and as a husband and father. New episodes weekdays.

item.title: Ep. 0006 — Simple (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
item.description: Plans and instructions have to be stripped down to what's essential and easily understood — complexity breeds confusion, and confusion breeds failure under pressure. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

item.title: Ep. 0005 — Cover and Move (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
item.description: Teams win through mutual support, not solo heroics — every part of the team is responsible for the success of every other part, because they all fail or succeed together. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

item.title: Ep. 0004 — Check the Ego (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
item.description: Ego clouds judgment, blinds a leader to real conditions, and prevents honest self-assessment — humility and objectivity have to win out over pride for good decisions to follow. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

item.title: Ep. 0003 — Believe (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
item.description: People will not fully commit to a mission until they understand and believe in the reason behind it — a leader must know the 'why' deeply enough to convince others of it. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

item.title: Ep. 0002 — No Bad Teams, Only Bad Leaders (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
item.description: A team's performance is a direct reflection of its leader's standards, attitude, and example — a struggling team is a leadership problem before it's a personnel problem. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

item.title: Ep. 0001 — Extreme Ownership (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
item.description: The leader owns everything in their world — every outcome, every failure, every gap — with zero excuses and zero blame passed down or sideways. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.
